description: PrefectHQ org baseline. Every repo extends this. Managers auto-detected; archetype presets (:python, :terraform, :go, :node, :helm, :flux) add grouping/scoping on top.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain day-0 cooldown: wait 7 days before bumping npm and PyPI packages (easy to publish; run install/build hooks -- the main day-0 attack surface) and GitHub Actions (run in CI with secrets). Terraform providers, docker images, and go modules are left on immediate updates -- lower day-0 risk and we do not want to delay their security patches.
Supply-chain day-0 cooldown for GitHub Actions (see the npm/pypi rule above).
Batch all minor/patch bumps into a single PR (mirrors the old updatecli manifest-minor run). More specific archetype groups carve their deps out of this batch.
Keep each major bump as its own PR and label it (mirrors the old manifest-major split). Majors are the riskiest updates and deserve isolated review.
Group GitHub Actions bumps into their own PR, separate from the general minor/patch batch. Universal: every repo has workflows.
Group mise tool bumps into their own PR, separate from the general minor/patch batch. Universal: every repo uses .mise.toml.
